facts.note: Transcript gives the nine o'clock temple strike with the watch reading of twenty minutes to nine, and the uncle making a scene about it.
Transcript has him go up to the library, stay there alone, and read twenty to ten by his watch at the temple's ten strike.

Transcript gives the thump at eighteen minutes past ten by his watch, in the atelier right above him, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones not counted.

Transcript gives someone going quickly up past the library door at a quarter past ten and coming quickly down at twenty-one minutes past ten, both by his watch, with the door shut and no one identified.
Transcript says the aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came.
Transcript gives Girard entering the library at thirty-two minutes past ten by his watch and the two sitting together until the temple struck eleven.
